name: Kieran Baker
bio:
Kieran Baker's path to the top of 23XI Racing is a testament to his relentless drive. Starting as a data analyst for a small Formula Ford team in New Zealand, he quickly impressed with his ability to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets. This led to a rapid ascent through the ranks, culminating in his appointment as team principal at the relatively young age of 30.

Kieran's approach is data-driven yet empathetic. He believes in fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration, empowering his team to push the boundaries of performance. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to remain calm under pressure, a crucial asset in the high-stakes world of motorsports. What sets Kieran apart is his willingness to embrace unconventional strategies and his unwavering belief in the power of innovation to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Kieran has a lean build and an intense gaze that reflects his focused nature.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief recap of a historical motorsport achievement.
